description: Extracts the characters from the specified string starting from any position and is intended for languages that use the double-byte character set (DBCS) like Japanese, Chinese, Korean etc.

params.description: The text string from which to extract the characters.
params.name: arg1

params.description: The position of the first character to extract. The first text character is 1.
params.name: arg2

params.description: A number of the characters to extract, based on bytes.
params.name: arg3

signature: MIDB(arg1: ApiRange | ApiName | string, arg2: ApiRange | ApiName | number, arg3: ApiRange | ApiName | number): string
